content: Nafcillin sodium for injection, USP, is a semisynthetic penicillin derived from the penicillin nucleus, specifically 6-aminopenicillanic acid. Its chemical name is Monosodium (2S, 5R, 6R)-6-(2-ethoxy-1-naphthamido)-3,3-dimethyl-7-oxo-4-thia-1-azabicycloheptane-2-carboxylate monohydrate. This compound is resistant to inactivation by the enzyme penicillinase, also known as beta-lactamase. Nafcillin sodium is provided as a sterile, white to yellowish-white powder intended for reconstitution. It is specifically formulated for intravenous administration. Each Pharmacy Bulk Package of Nafcillin for injection, USP, contains nafcillin sodium in its monohydrate form, equivalent to 10 grams of nafcillin. The formulation is buffered with 40 mg of sodium citrate per gram of nafcillin, and it also contains 78 mg of sodium per gram. A Pharmacy Bulk Package is a container of sterile dosage form that includes multiple single doses. The contents of this package are designed for use in a pharmacy admixture program and are restricted to the preparation of admixtures for intravenous infusion.
